route_title: Round-2 Best Seed with Halved Step-Size and ±2.0nm Inter-Round Delta Clip
compilation_rationale: Task compiles a fixed 24-layer TiO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica at 45° incidence. Initial thicknesses are applied directly. Four soft objectives score high reflectance/transmittance in the designated bands while explicitly penalizing cross-band leakage. Optimizer learning rate halved and quantization set to 2 nm to emulate the specified step-size multiplier and delta clip.
